formulations.name: Astakatvara Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Oil 640 gm cooked with rock salt, sunthi, pippalimula, citraka, bhallataka nuts and sour gruel 5.12 litres

formulations.name: Mustard oil with Kustha and Devadaru (for Urustambha)
formulations.preparation_method: Mustard oil cooked with the mentioned drugs and added with honey in proper dose

formulations.name: Oil with Piluparni group (for Urustambha)
formulations.preparation_method: Oil cooked with piluparni, payasya, rasni, goksura, vaca, sarala, aguru and patha; taken with honey
formulations.dosage: 86 gm or 160 gm added with honey

formulations.name: Balataila (Vatavyadhi)
formulations.preparation_method: Oil 2.56 kg cooked with juice of sahacara 4 kg, paste of its root 400 gm and four times milk. When prepared, powder of sharkara 720 gm dissolved in it.

formulations.name: Goksura (Swadamstra) Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Oil 640 gm cooked with juice of goksura 1.28 litres, equal quantity of milk, sunthi and jaggery
formulations.dosage: When digested, gruel with milk should be taken as diet

formulations.name: Balataila (Krsnatreya - major formulation)
formulations.preparation_method: Oil 2.56 kg cooked with decoction of bala 4 kg, guduchi 1 kg, rasna 500 gm in water 2.56 litres reduced to one-tenth, with curd-water, sugarcane juice and sukta each equal to oil, goat's milk in half quantity and paste of the listed drugs each 40 gm. After preparation, filtered and added with paste of aromatic leaves.

formulations.name: Amrta Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Guduchi 20 kg boiled in water 81.92 litres reduced to one-fourth. With this decoction, oil 5.12 kg cooked with equal quantity of milk and paste of all listed drugs.

formulations.name: Rasna Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Oil 10.24 kg cooked in decoction of rasna 40 kg with paste of aromatic drugs from Himalayas and Eladi group drugs

formulations.name: Malakadya Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Equal quantities of milk, oil, sour curd and sour gruel cooked together with paste of listed drugs

formulations.name: Vyashamuladi Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Oil 2.56 kg cooked with decoction of vasa root and guduchi 8 kg (4 kg each), citraka and ashwagandha 4 kg (2 kg each) along with milk. More effective when Eladi group drugs added.
indications: Patients broken and shattered by disorders of Vata

formulations.name: Malaka Taila (Mulaka Taila)
formulations.preparation_method: All decoction drugs 400 gm each made into decoction. With this, oil 540 gm cooked with paste of sarvagandha group each 10 gm along with curd, sour gruel, sour liquid of horse gram, radish juice and sugarcane juice each 640 ml.

formulations.name: Nirgundi Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Oil cooked with equal quantity of juice taken from root and leaves of nirgundi

formulations.name: Mahasneha (Great Fat formulation)
formulations.preparation_method: Listed drugs boiled in water 10.24 litres reduced to one-fourth. Then urine, sour gruel, sour curd, dadima, yakshamla, oil, fat, ghee, marrow, milk and paste of vitaliser drugs 240 gm added and cooked.

formulations.name: Dashamula Ghrita (Vatavyadhi)
formulations.preparation_method: Dashamula 160 gm and yava, kola, kulattha 640 gm each boiled in water 10.24 litres reduced to one-fourth. With this decoction and paste of vitaliser drugs along with sharkara, kharjara, kasmarya, draksha, badara, phalgu and milk, ghee 640 gm cooked.
indications: Used as intake, massage and enema
formulations.dosage: Used as intake, massage and enema

formulations.name: Parusaka Ghrita
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with paste of trayamana, tamalaki, kakoli, ksirakakoli, shatavari and kaseruka and decoction of same drugs adding thereto juices of parusaka, draksha, kasmarya, sugarcane and vidari in equal quantity and milk four times.

formulations.name: Jivaniya Ghrita
formulations.preparation_method: Drugs 80 gm each boiled in water 10.24 litres reduced to one-fourth. Milk, amalaka juice, sugarcane juice, goat's flesh soup added with ghee 2.56 kg and cooked on mild fire with paste of secondary drugs. When prepared, honey added and stored in clean container with prescribed ritual.

formulations.name: Madhuparnyadi Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Madhuka 4 kg decocted in water reduced to one-fourth. With this, oil 2.56 kg cooked with equal quantity of milk and paste of listed drugs each 40 gm.
formulations.dosage: Used in four ways: intake, massage, snuff and enema

formulations.name: Sukumaraka Taila
formulations.preparation_method: First drugs boiled in water 40.96 litres reduced to one-eighth. Filtered. With this, oil 2.56 kg cooked with equal quantity juices of amalaka, kasmarya, vidari, sugarcane and milk 40.96 litres and paste of drugs 40 gm each. When prepared honey 640 gm added.
formulations.dosage: Used as snuff, massage, intake and enema

formulations.name: Amrtadya Taila (Amrta Taila for Vatarakta)
formulations.preparation_method: All drugs except paste drugs boiled in water 1024 litres reduced to 40.96 litres. With this, oil 10.24 litres cooked with five times milk and paste of candana, usira, nagakesara, patra, ela, aguru, kustha, tagara, madhuyasti each 120 gm and manjistha 320 gm.
formulations.dosage: Used in all ways (intake, massage, snuff, enema)

formulations.name: Mahapadmaka Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Padmaka and other drugs each 200 gm decocted in water. With this, oil cooked with equal quantity of sauvira and paste of drugs 20 gm each and manjistha 40 gm.

formulations.name: Khuddaka Padmaka Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Oil prepared with decoction of padmaka, usira, madhuyasti and haridra along with paste of sarja, manjistha, vita, kakoli and candana.

formulations.name: Madhuka Taila (cooked hundred times)
formulations.preparation_method: Madhuyasti 4 kg boiled with ten times milk reduced to one-fourth. With this, oil 40.96 kg cooked with paste or juice of madhuka repeatedly. Process repeated 100 times so that 100 pala (4 kg) of madhuka is processed.

formulations.name: Bala Taila (cooked hundred or thousand times)
formulations.preparation_method: Oil cooked with decoction and paste of bala with equal quantity of milk, repeated hundred or thousand times
indications: Alleviator of defects of semen and ovum

formulations.name: Pinda Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Oil prepared with beewax, manjistha, sarjarasa and sariva

formulations.name: Triphala-Trikatu Paste (Vatarakta)
formulations.preparation_method: All in equal quantity pounded. Paste applied on iron utensil in early morning and eaten in noon.
indications: Pain of vatarakta even caused by all three doshas
formulations.dosage: Applied on iron utensil in early morning, eaten in noon
